marks.gloss_en: כיון דאפשר למעבד חטה אחת כדשמואל -- Shmuel's single grain shows what the Israelite could have done instead

אי דחשידי להכי, אפרושי נמי לא לפרשו! -- if Israelites were suspected of [planting teruma to be rid of it], they would not separate teruma at all; since they could discharge it with one grain and do not, they are trusted
Shmuel, as cited by Rava: [teruma can be given with] a single grain of wheat
Shmuel: growths of teruma are teruma too
Beit Shammai: one may not soak ink, dye-plants or vetch unless there is time for them to soak while it is still day
Beit Shammai: one may not spread traps for beasts, birds and fish unless there is time for them to be caught while it is still day
Ulla: one for whom it grew dark on the road gives his purse to a gentile
הניחא לרבי מאיר, אלא לרבי יוסי שבסרי הויין -- this works for R' Meir, but for R' Yosei they are seventeen
איכא הא דרב אחא בר אדא -- there is also Rav Acha bar Adda's [dictum in R' Yitzchak's name], by which bread and oil were decreed separately (= p_pat_mishum_shemen, p_shemen_mishum_yayin)
Avimi of Sanvata: their bread, their oil, their wine and their daughters -- all of them are of the eighteen matters
אי הכי, לרבי מאיר נמי תשסרי הויין -- if so, for R' Meir too they are nineteen
אוכלין וכלים שנטמאו במשקין בחדא חשיב להו -- foods and vessels made impure by liquids he counts as one
על פתן משום שמנן?! מאי אולמיה דשמן מפת -- in what is oil stronger than bread, that bread should be decreed because of it?
rather: they decreed on their bread [and their oil] because of their wine
